name: input
title: Input
description: A text input field for forms and user data entry, with built-in styling and accessibility features.
accessibilityNotes: Renders a native `<input>` element, so it inherits every built-in keyboard, screen-reader, and form-submission behavior of the platform control — no ARIA role or custom key handling is added.
Always pair the input with a visible label: either a `Label`/`FieldLabel` with a matching `for`/`id`, or an `aria-label`/`aria-labelledby` when no visible label fits (e.g. an icon-only search field).
Set `aria-invalid="true"` (and, inside a `Field`, `invalid`) when validation fails — screen readers announce the invalid state, and `FieldError` can describe why via `aria-describedby`.
Set `disabled` to remove the control from the tab order and block pointer input; prefer `aria-disabled` with `readonly` instead when the value must still be announced or submitted.

examples.title: Field group
examples.source:
import Button from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/button/button.marko";
import Field from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/field/field.marko";
import FieldDescription from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/field/field-description.marko";
import FieldGroup from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/field/field-group.marko";
import FieldLabel from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/field/field-label.marko";
import TextInput from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/input/input.marko";

<FieldGroup>
  <Field>
    <FieldLabel for="fieldgroup-name">Name</FieldLabel>
    <TextInput id="fieldgroup-name" placeholder="Jordan Lee"/>
  </Field>
  <Field>
    <FieldLabel for="fieldgroup-email">Email</FieldLabel>
    <TextInput id="fieldgroup-email" type="email" placeholder="name@example.com"/>
    <FieldDescription>We'll send updates to this address.</FieldDescription>
  </Field>
  <Field orientation="horizontal">
    <Button type="reset" variant="outline">Reset</Button>
    <Button type="submit">Submit</Button>
  </Field>
</FieldGroup>
examples.description: Use `FieldGroup` to show multiple `Field` blocks and to build forms.

examples.title: Grid
examples.source:
import Field from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/field/field.marko";
import FieldGroup from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/field/field-group.marko";
import FieldLabel from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/field/field-label.marko";
import TextInput from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/input/input.marko";

<FieldGroup class="grid max-w-sm grid-cols-2">
  <Field>
    <FieldLabel for="grid-first-name">First Name</FieldLabel>
    <TextInput id="grid-first-name" placeholder="Jordan"/>
  </Field>
  <Field>
    <FieldLabel for="grid-last-name">Last Name</FieldLabel>
    <TextInput id="grid-last-name" placeholder="Lee"/>
  </Field>
</FieldGroup>
examples.description: Use a grid layout to place multiple inputs side by side.

examples.title: Input group
examples.source:
import Field from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/field/field.marko";
import FieldLabel from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/field/field-label.marko";
import InputGroup from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/input-group/input-group.marko";
import InputGroupAddon from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/input-group/addon.marko";
import InputGroupInput from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/input-group/input.marko";
import InputGroupText from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/input-group/text.marko";

<Field>
  <FieldLabel for="input-group-url">Website URL</FieldLabel>
  <InputGroup>
    <InputGroupInput id="input-group-url" placeholder="example.com"/>
    <InputGroupAddon>
      <InputGroupText>https://</InputGroupText>
    </InputGroupAddon>
    <InputGroupAddon align="inline-end">
      <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="size-4">
        <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/>
        <path d="M12 16v-4"/>
        <path d="M12 8h.01"/>
      </svg>
    </InputGroupAddon>
  </InputGroup>
</Field>
examples.description: To add icons, text, or buttons inside an input, use the `InputGroup` component. See the Input Group component for more examples.
